label: prf:skew-poisson-integration
title: Proof of Integration of skewed-Poisson structures
html: This is the Main Theorem of Fresse. Item (1) is the existence statement; item (2) follows from the Grobner--Shirshov normal-form construction for \mathrm{Dist}(G); item (3) is the strong multiplicativity theorem, which guarantees that the co-multiplication is compatible with the deformed product at every stage of the \pp-adic filtration.
